title: Marvel's Avengers:Age Of Ultron
desc: Tony Stark builds an artificial intelligence system named Ultron with the help of Bruce Banner. When the sentient Ultron makes plans to wipe out the human race, the Avengers set out to stop him.

title: Doctor Strange In The Multiverse Of Madness
desc: Doctor Strange allies with a mysterious girl from his dreams, a multiverse traveler, to combat threats, including alternate versions of himself, endangering the entire multiverse.

title: Mojin The Treasure Valley
desc: An adventurer explores an ancient valley seeking treasure and truth, uncovering secrets, battling legends, and testing loyalty in a mystical underground world.

title: The Lion King
desc: Simba, a young lion prince, flees his kingdom after the murder of his father, Mufasa. Years later, a chance encounter with Nala, a lioness, causes him to return and take back what is rightfully his.

title: Avengers: End Game
desc: After Thanos wipes out half the universe, the Avengers reunite to rally their fallen allies and restore balance, embarking on an epic quest to save existence itself.

title: Darkroom
desc: Michelle takes a job recommended by her counselor that lands her trapped in a mansion with three psychotic siblings hell bent on purging Michelle of her sins.
